title: Cohomology pullback detected by the homology of the derived unit
statement: Let p:Y\to E be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Assume that global sections on abelian etale sheaves on E [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] preserves finite colimits and reflects isomorphisms. For an abelian etale sheaf G on E and q\geq0, the canonical cohomology pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] is bijective if and only if H^q of the derived inverse-image/direct-image adjunction unit G[0]\to Rp_*p^{-1}G[0] is an isomorphism of sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. The definition derivedPullbackUnitHomology denotes precisely this H^q map.

proof.text: The existing Ext-to-derived-global-sections comparison conjugates cohomology pullback to H^q(RGamma(eta) followed by Leray). Both conjugating maps and Leray are invertible. Exactness gives the natural comparison RGamma = D(Gamma) and lets homology commute with Gamma. Naturality identifies H^q(RGamma(eta)) with Gamma(H^q eta) up to invertible comparison maps. Reflection of isomorphisms by Gamma finishes the equivalence.

theorem bijective_cohomologyMap_iff_isIso_derivedPullbackUnitHomology
    {Y E : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ E)
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (Sheaf.Γ E.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [(Sheaf.Γ E.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).ReflectsIsomorphisms]
    (G : Sheaf E.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (cohomologyMap p G q) ↔
      IsIso (derivedPullbackUnitHomology p G q)
